concerns.text: The `outcome_model` enum in `estimation_result.schema.yaml` lists `quadratic` but the specification, plan, and tasks use the identifier `quadratic_missing_sine`. This mismatch will cause schema validation failures for all `EstimationResult` records generated by the pipeline, violating FR‑001/FR‑002 and breaking the contract validation task (T012). Align the enum to include `quadratic_missing_sine` (or rename all task references to `quadratic`).
